Module 1: Introduction to Geometry

The study of shapes, sizes, and the properties of space.

Video Content
Explanation
Geometry is a branch of mathematics that deals with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs. It is one of the oldest branches of mathematics, having arisen in response to practical problems in surveying, construction, and astronomy.
Key Points
Points, lines, and planes are the fundamental building blocks of geometry.
Euclidean geometry is based on the work of the Greek mathematician Euclid.
Angles are formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint called a vertex.
